# Roy Para Olivera

> Full-stack developer in training based in Vecindario, Gran Canaria (Spain). Studying a Higher VET Diploma in Multiplatform Application Development (DAM) at IES Lomo de la Herradura, 2025 – present. Open to internships and junior roles.

- Experience: web developer intern at Fraemma (Telde), May – June 2026. Took part in migrating and further developing a private ERP/CRM with PHP and Laravel.
- Main languages: Java, JavaScript, SQL. Also PHP, Kotlin, Python, React, Vite, Bootstrap, Node.js, Laravel, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, AWS, Git.
- Spoken languages: Spanish (native), English (C1 Advanced, Cambridge, overall score 186, June 2024), German (Goethe-Zertifikat B1, April 2024).
- Contact: roypara@icloud.com · +34 611 146 257
